senses.definition: Pertaining to, furnished with, or expressed by letters of the alphabet.

quotes.text: Paul, who talks about what the magical papyri do, has in his first letter to the Corinthians described basic aspects of alphabetical language.
quotes.reference: 1986, Arthur Hilary Armstrong, A. A. Armstrong, Classical Mediterranean Spirituality: Egyptian, Greek, Roman, page 486:

senses.definition: According to the sequence of the letters of the alphabet.
examples: All names were placed into an alphabetical list.

quotes.text: But if an alphabeticall servility must be still urged, it may so fall out,
quotes.reference: 1644, John Milton, The Doctrine & Discipline of Divorce, page 31:

quotes.text: We used to publish two, or sometimes three, alphabeticals a year and I am proposing to resume the same sort of frequency.
